repeats.line: You walk to the trap line with Soo. Nothing much there — but they talk the whole way, and you learn the shape of them a little better.

repeats.line: "Take it with salt. What did you want to ask?"

repeats.name: Daniyar
repeats.line: "Here's a story: Rafael once stayed up all night on watch so someone else could sleep. That's who Rafael is, when it counts."

repeats.name: Patrick
